shelters.name: Humane Society of Missouri
shelters.description: Committed to the prevention of abuse and neglect of animals through adoption, veterinary care, rescue and rehabilitation. One of Missouri's largest humane societies.

shelters.name: KC Pet Project
shelters.description: Opens doors to over 16,000 animals annually. In 2024, cared for 16,028 animals with 10,436 adopted, 9,482 spay/neuter surgeries, and 1,856 lost pets reunited with families.

shelters.name: Stray Rescue of St. Louis
shelters.description: Has hundreds of wonderful dogs and cats looking for forever homes. Open daily 10AM-7PM for adoptions.

shelters.name: Open Door Animal Sanctuary
shelters.description: Founded 1975, largest no-kill shelter in greater St. Louis area and State of Missouri. Takes in stray, abused, neglected and unwanted cats and dogs.

shelters.name: Humane Society of Southwest Missouri
shelters.description: Non-profit, no-kill animal shelter in Springfield that rescues dogs and cats and finds loving adoptive homes for them.

shelters.name: Central Missouri Humane Society
shelters.description: Putting Pets with People since 1943. Open Mon-Fri 12-6, Sat 12-5, Sun 12-3.

shelters.name: APA Adoption Center
shelters.description: Animal Protective Association of Missouri serves the St. Louis region for dog, cat and pet adoption, wellness, and ongoing education.

shelters.name: CARE STL
shelters.description: Center for Animal Rescue and Enrichment is a 501(c)(3) nonprofit managing the City of St. Louis shelter, working to increase live-release rates.

shelters.name: Metro East Humane Society
shelters.description: Since 1986, enriching lives of people, cats, and dogs. Saved 1,900 lives in 2024, distributed 20,000 lbs of free pet food. No-kill shelter.

shelters.name: Franklin County Humane Society
shelters.description: Where Paws and People Meet. Participates in BISSELL Pet Foundation's Empty the Shelters nationwide adoption events.

shelters.name: Northeast Missouri Humane Society
shelters.description: Conducting capital campaign to continue making a difference in the lives of humans and animals in northeast Missouri.

shelters.name: Branson Humane Society
shelters.description: Serves homeless dogs and cats in Branson area. Launched Snip City in June 2025 for low-cost spay/neuter services. Operates adoption center and two thrift stores.

shelters.name: New Nodaway Humane Society
shelters.description: No-kill animal shelter giving shelter and care to lost, abused, or unwanted dogs and cats, advocating for humane treatment and reducing overpopulation.

shelters.name: Southeast Missouri Pets Adoption Center
shelters.description: Offers expanded humane education space with classrooms for camps, school visits, and programs promoting empathy and kindness.

shelters.name: Country Acres Rescue
shelters.description: Receives no government funding, entirely dependent on adoption fees and charitable donations. Provides safe, secure, healthy environment for pets.

shelters.name: St. Charles County Pet Adoption Center
shelters.description: Open Admissions Shelter accepting authorized stray animals regardless of adoptability. Works with area shelters and rescue groups, has active foster parent program.

notes: Comprehensive collection of Missouri animal shelters, humane societies, and rescue organizations. KC Pet Project serves 16,000+ animals annually. Open Door Animal Sanctuary (founded 1975) is Missouri's largest no-kill shelter. Central Missouri Humane Society has served since 1943. Coverage spans St. Louis metro, Kansas City, Springfield, Columbia, Branson, and rural communities.
